name: Microsoft Copilot
summary: Microsoft's AI assistant woven through Windows, Edge and Microsoft 365 — chat plus in-document help. In 2026 the personal and work apps are being merged into one Copilot app.
freeTierNotes: Free tier available; deeper Microsoft 365 integration is tied to paid plans that change over time — check official docs.
tosNotes: Educational interactive use by end learners; work-account data handling differs from consumer — see official terms.
